segments.text: Emoji comes from the word emotion. Nope. That's a total coincidence.
Emoji is Japanese. E means picture, and moji means character. Picture character.
In {1999,|nineteen ninety nine,} a designer named Shigetaka Kurita drew a famous early set for Japanese phones. {176|One hundred seventy six} tiny icons, each just twelve by twelve pixels.
Here's the wild part. The word you're thinking of is emoticon, the sideways smiley. That one really is emotion plus icon. Emoji just sounds the same.
In fact, Kurita's tiny icons are now in the Museum of Modern Art in New York.
And in {2015,|twenty fifteen,} Oxford's word of the year wasn't even a word. It was the face with tears of joy.
So emoji has nothing to do with emotion. Funny, because now it's how we show all of them.
